title: padsequences
summary: Pad or truncate numeric sequence cell arrays.
description: `padsequences(sequences, paddingDim)` pads or truncates numeric sequences stored in a cell array along the requested dimension.
behaviors: `sequences` must be a cell array of numeric scalar/vector/tensor sequences.
`paddingDim` is a required positive integer dimension.
`PaddingValue` accepts a finite numeric scalar and defaults to `0`.
`UniformOutput` defaults to `true` and stacks padded sequences into a numeric tensor; `false` preserves the input cell shape.

examples.output: A numeric tensor with right-padded row sequences.
A cell array whose first sequence keeps the tail `[2 3]`.

example.input:
Y = padsequences(sequences, paddingDim)
Y = padsequences(sequences, paddingDim, Name, Value)
example.output: Numeric tensor by default, or cell array when `UniformOutput` is false.

gpu_residency: `padsequences` materializes host sequence tensors in this slice; provider-resident sequence padding remains future GPU work.
